blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The Department of Labor and Employment (Dole) on Oct. 8 began a probe into workplace safety and conditions aboard the M/V June Aster following the deadly fire off Coron, Palawan. Labor Secretary Francis Tolentino chaired the Lupong Pamagawa inquiry to determine possible compliance failures that may have contributed to the disaster. The vessel, operated by Atienza Interisland Ferries Inc., caught fire on Sept. 9 while en route to Palawan from Manila. Of the 128 passengers and crew members listed in the manifest, 77 died while 43 survived, according to recent reports. Initial reports said an explosion involving an unidentified object […]...
